format: bun scripts/gbg-osm.ts. The tram tracks in the city frame (src/game/city/geo.ts), meters. links: a track one way, from one junction to the next (from/to: OSM nodes, -1 where it runs out of the area), the links a tram may go on to (next), the same track the other way (twin), its length and points (centimeters, the first as it is and each next from the one before, eased so no curve is tighter than 18 m). stops: OSM's tram stops, as a link and s along it. blocks: one tram at a time, as [link, from s, to s] (on the twin too). conflicts: pairs of blocks that cannot hold trams at once (a switch, a crossing).
